name: deepseek_harness_chrome
description: DeepSeek Harness browser extension shell with a Native Messaging backend.

scripts.dev: pnpm build:harness-client-plugins && pnpm sync-harness-assets && node scripts/prepare-dev-port.mjs && pnpm --dir apps/chrome-extension run dev
scripts.build: pnpm build:harness-client-plugins && pnpm sync-harness-assets && pnpm --dir apps/chrome-extension run build
scripts.zip: pnpm build:harness-client-plugins && pnpm sync-harness-assets && pnpm --dir apps/chrome-extension run zip
scripts.typecheck:plugins: pnpm --filter @accrui/harness-ui-agent-preset run typecheck && pnpm --filter @accrui/harness-ui-browser-target run typecheck && pnpm --filter @accrui/harness-ui-conversation-shell run typecheck && pnpm --filter @accrui/harness-ui-responsive-sidebar run typecheck && pnpm --filter @accrui/harness-ui-workspace-picker run typecheck && pnpm --filter @accrui/harness-ui-knowledge-scope run typecheck && pnpm --filter @accrui/harness-ui-subagent-compact run typecheck && pnpm --filter @accrui/harness-ui-session-log-copy run typecheck && pnpm --filter @accrui/harness-ui-settings-shell run typecheck && pnpm --filter @accrui/harness-skill-settings run typecheck
scripts.dev:setup:windows: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build:harness-product && pnpm register-native-host
